tub.note: Freestanding broad low wooden tub, circulation around it. East side PinPin; south spill runs toward entry. Do not push tub against wall.

location.doors: Bath opens75° into bath; bedroom opens into common and closes after opening beats; front opens outward for cleanup. Two radial round windows flank green front door; bathroom one round window.

location.illustrationPolicy: New props are draft movable dressing, not silent permanent canonical geometry edits. Camera positions are proposed staging; if using location-render workflow execute each saved camera and inspect, not merely claim Blender validation.

magic.rule: One fixed horizontal gold circle above shallow tub water, clockwise tracing creates a small continual fountain into tub. Same gesture counterclockwise erases ring and stops NEW water only. No extra streams at floor or self-moving buckets.
magic.viewConvention: Clockwise/counterclockwise judged looking down onto horizontal ring from same side; preserve camera, landmarks, paw and visible short leading trail. Viewer must see erasure rather than a second circle.
magic.waterOrigin: One gentle fountain from ring, not a wall faucet. Gold ring remains above water surface as water rises, keeping XY fixed; elevation follows surface by a small constant clearance.
magic.floorWater: Spreads through open threshold; shallow, never chest-high or whole-house swimming. Reversal never drains existing water.
magic.cleanup: Remove excess clean tub water separately; scoop dirty floor water for outside; mop, hang rug, then supervised shallow bath. Recovered wooden duck returns in34 andbreakfast35.
rules: Clockwise bathcircle continually makeswater; counterclockwise erasure stopsnewwateronly.
